mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have overcast skies and a temperature of 75 degrees, which feels like 80 degrees, near the Verona Public Library. The moon phase is a waxing crescent.

The Verona Senior Center is currently seeking volunteers to assist with their programs. Volunteers must commit to at least two shifts per month and may need to perform tasks like lifting or climbing stairs. You can apply online or at the center, but please be aware that all volunteers must sign a confidentiality agreement and pass a background check if they work with seniors.

Today is packed with activities, including the Dane County Farmers Market and live music at Bailey's Run, Paddy Mac's, and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, check out the Cave Carnival at Cave of the Mounds or the Girls Try Hockey event at the Verona Ice Arena.

In our weekly police report, on August 5, officers were called to the 500 block of Whalen Road to locate a man with an outstanding warrant. The subject attempted to flee but was eventually taken into custody and faces new charges.
Today is the perfect day to stop by for the Turtle flavor of the day. The store is open until 10:30 PM, so there is plenty of time to grab a treat.
